description: Personal finance dashboard powered by Monzo. Transactions tagged 'internal' or 'savings' are excluded from all totals.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS value
FROM transactions
WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
  AND amount > 0
  AND CASE WHEN '${category:csv}' = '*' THEN category NOT IN ('internal', 'savings')
           ELSE category = ANY(string_to_array('${category:csv}', ',')) END
  AND ('${group:csv}' = '*' OR group_id = ANY(string_to_array('${group:csv}', ',')) OR offset_for_group = ANY(string_to_array('${group:csv}', ',')));

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(-amount), 0) AS value
FROM transactions
WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
  AND amount < 0
  AND CASE WHEN '${category:csv}' = '*' THEN category NOT IN ('internal', 'savings')
           ELSE category = ANY(string_to_array('${category:csv}', ',')) END
  AND ('${group:csv}' = '*' OR group_id = ANY(string_to_array('${group:csv}', ',')) OR offset_for_group = ANY(string_to_array('${group:csv}', ',')));

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(-amount), 0) AS value
FROM personal_spend_daily
WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
  AND (amount < 0 OR is_reimbursement)
  AND CASE WHEN '${category:csv}' = '*' THEN category NOT IN ('internal', 'savings')
           ELSE category = ANY(string_to_array('${category:csv}', ',')) END
  AND ('${group:csv}' = '*' OR group_id = ANY(string_to_array('${group:csv}', ',')));

WITH income AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS v
  FROM transactions
  WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
    AND amount > 0
    AND CASE WHEN '${category:csv}' = '*' THEN category NOT IN ('internal', 'savings')
             ELSE category = ANY(string_to_array('${category:csv}', ',')) END
    AND ('${group:csv}' = '*' OR group_id = ANY(string_to_array('${group:csv}', ',')) OR offset_for_group = ANY(string_to_array('${group:csv}', ',')))
), spend AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(-amount), 0) AS v
  FROM personal_spend_daily
  WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
    AND amount < 0
    AND CASE WHEN '${category:csv}' = '*' THEN category NOT IN ('internal', 'savings')
             ELSE category = ANY(string_to_array('${category:csv}', ',')) END
    AND ('${group:csv}' = '*' OR group_id = ANY(string_to_array('${group:csv}', ',')))
)
SELECT (income.v - spend.v) AS value FROM income, spend;

panels.description: Spend Monzo left in 'general' or 'unknown' — candidates for categories.yaml overrides.

  AND ('${group:csv}' = '*' OR group_id = ANY(string_to_array('${group:csv}', ',')) OR offset_for_group = ANY(string_to_array('${group:csv}', ',')));

panels.title: Uncategorised spend

panels.description: Average raw spend per month over the selected range. Excludes internal/savings.

targets.rawSql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', occurred_at) AS m, SUM(-amount) AS spend
  FROM transactions
  WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
    AND amount < 0
    AND CASE WHEN '${category:csv}' = '*' THEN category NOT IN ('internal', 'savings')
             ELSE category = ANY(string_to_array('${category:csv}', ',')) END
    AND ('${group:csv}' = '*' OR group_id = ANY(string_to_array('${group:csv}', ',')) OR offset_for_group = ANY(string_to_array('${group:csv}', ',')))
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(spend), 0) AS value FROM monthly;

panels.title: Avg monthly spend

targets.rawSql:
SELECT

  'Raw spend' AS metric,
  SUM(-amount) AS value
FROM transactions
WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
  AND amount < 0
  AND CASE WHEN '${category:csv}' = '*' THEN category NOT IN ('internal', 'savings')
           ELSE category = ANY(string_to_array('${category:csv}', ',')) END
  AND ('${group:csv}' = '*' OR group_id = ANY(string_to_array('${group:csv}', ',')) OR offset_for_group = ANY(string_to_array('${group:csv}', ',')))
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT

  AND ('${group:csv}' = '*' OR group_id = ANY(string_to_array('${group:csv}', ',')))

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day AS time, account_id AS metric, balance AS value
FROM net_worth_daily
WHERE $__timeFilter(day)
ORDER BY day;

panels.title: Net worth — by account

panels.description: Sum across all accounts. Monzo running balance + last-known snapshot per other account.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day AS time, 'Total' AS metric, SUM(balance) AS value
FROM net_worth_daily
WHERE $__timeFilter(day)

panels.title: Net worth — total

panels.description: Gross cost (post-split), reimbursements, and net cost per holiday/lease/project.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT name, gross_cost, reimbursed, net_cost
FROM group_costs
WHERE (COALESCE(gross_cost, 0) <> 0 OR COALESCE(reimbursed, 0) <> 0)
  AND ('${group:csv}' = '*' OR id = ANY(string_to_array('${group:csv}', ',')))
ORDER BY starts_at DESC NULLS LAST;

panels.title: Net cost per group

panels.description: Drill into a group: every transaction that fed it, with personal share applied. Pick a group from the dropdown.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.occurred_at, t.merchant, (t.amount * t.my_share)::numeric(12,2) AS personal, t.description,
       CASE WHEN t.offset_for_group IS NOT NULL THEN 'reimbursement' ELSE 'spend' END AS kind
FROM transactions t
WHERE (t.group_id IS NOT NULL OR t.offset_for_group IS NOT NULL)
  AND (
    '${group:csv}' = '*'
    OR t.group_id = ANY(string_to_array('${group:csv}', ','))
    OR t.offset_for_group = ANY(string_to_array('${group:csv}', ','))
  )
  AND ('${category:csv}' = '*' OR t.category = ANY(string_to_array('${category:csv}', ',')))
ORDER BY t.occurred_at DESC;

panels.title: Group detail

panels.description: Cumulative net cost per group within the selected time window. Each step adds a month's gross spend (post-split) and subtracts that month's reimbursements, so the right-hand edge of each line is the running total. Use the Group selector to focus on one lease/holiday/project.

targets.rawSql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT $__timeGroup(occurred_at, '1M') AS time,
         COALESCE(group_id, offset_for_group) AS group_id,
         SUM(CASE
           WHEN group_id IS NOT NULL THEN -amount * my_share
           ELSE -amount
         END) AS monthly_value
  FROM transactions
  WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
    AND (group_id IS NOT NULL OR offset_for_group IS NOT NULL)
    AND ('${group:csv}' = '*'
         OR group_id = ANY(string_to_array('${group:csv}', ','))
         OR offset_for_group = ANY(string_to_array('${group:csv}', ',')))
    AND ('${category:csv}' = '*' OR category = ANY(string_to_array('${category:csv}', ',')))
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT time,
       group_id AS metric,
       SUM(monthly_value) OVER (PARTITION BY group_id ORDER BY time) AS value
FROM monthly
ORDER BY 1, 2;

panels.title: Group cost — cumulative

panels.description: Monthly net of income minus true personal spend. Positive = saved that month.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroup(occurred_at, '1M') AS time, 'Net' AS metric, SUM(amount) AS value
FROM personal_spend_daily
WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
  AND ('${category:csv}' = '*' OR category = ANY(string_to_array('${category:csv}', ',')))
  AND ('${group:csv}' = '*' OR group_id = ANY(string_to_array('${group:csv}', ',')))
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Savings velocity (income − personal spend)

panels.description: True personal spend so far this calendar month (post-split, post-amortise). Edit panel to set your monthly target via thresholds.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(-amount), 0) AS value
FROM personal_spend_daily
WHERE date_trunc('month', occurred_at) = date_trunc('month', NOW())
  AND (amount < 0 OR is_reimbursement)
  AND ('${category:csv}' = '*' OR category = ANY(string_to_array('${category:csv}', ',')))
  AND ('${group:csv}' = '*' OR group_id = ANY(string_to_array('${group:csv}', ',')));

panels.title: Budget — this month

panels.description: Incoming Monzo transfers not categorised as income/internal/savings and not linked to any offset. Click merchant → set offset_for_group or category=internal. When this is empty, you're reconciled.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT occurred_at, amount, merchant, description, category, id AS transaction_id
FROM transactions
WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
  AND amount > 0
  AND CASE WHEN '${category:csv}' = '*' THEN category NOT IN ('income', 'internal', 'savings')
           ELSE category = ANY(string_to_array('${category:csv}', ',')) END
  AND ('${group:csv}' = '*' OR group_id = ANY(string_to_array('${group:csv}', ',')) OR offset_for_group = ANY(string_to_array('${group:csv}', ',')))
  AND offset_for_tx IS NULL
  AND offset_for_group IS NULL
ORDER BY occurred_at DESC;

panels.title: Reconciliation queue

panels.description: Vanguard ISA value (line) vs total deposited (line). Gap = market gain. Snapshot via `python poller.py snapshot vanguard_isa YYYY-MM-DD BAL CONTRIB`.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT observed_at::timestamptz AS time,
       balance               AS "Value",
       contributions_to_date AS "Deposited"
FROM account_balances
WHERE account_id = 'vanguard_isa'
  AND $__timeFilter(observed_at::timestamptz)
ORDER BY observed_at;
